author: trackreco
body:
Replaces the production of `trackerRecoMaterial.xml` for `T35` tracker geometry (under `Tracker_DD4hep_compatible_IT711_2023_05`) with a Geant4-derived material map produced using the standard Tracking POG tools:
- `SimTracker/TrackerMaterialAnalysis/test/trackingMaterialProducer10GeVNeutrino_ForPhaseII.py`, using 200k neutrino-gun events;
- `SimTracker/TrackerMaterialAnalysis/test/trackingMaterialAnalyser_ForPhaseII.py`.

The new material map uses 404 material groups, compared to the 27 tkLayout-derived groups currently shipped in production. The new grouping assigns each sensor volume to an individual group and provides additional  segmentation of the Inner Tracker Layer 1/Layer 2 flipped/unflipped rod configurations. Neither of these features is distinguished in the current production map.

Since this replaces the `trackerRecoMaterial.xml` file already loaded by default whenever T35 is used, no additional configuration changes are required to use the new material map. This affects **reconstruction** steps only.

Note on normal incidence: the reported values are not raw Geant4 path lengths. The existing `TrackingMaterialAnalyser/MaterialAccountingDetector` chain projects each step onto the sensor's local normal before accumulating the contributions into `TrackerRadLength/TrackerXi`. The corresponding cos weighting is computed in `TrackingMaterialProducer` from `solid.SurfaceNormal `at the point where the step enters the sensitive volume.

Physics validation on ttbar at the HLT Phase-2 baseline (`CMSSW_20_1_0_pre3`, 500 events) shows unchanged tracking efficiency with a 10-20% better transverse momentum resolution in the barrel and transition region. The absolute fake rate increases marginally, likely because the track-quality MVA was trained with the previous material description; this could be recovered by retuning.

[ttbar performance at HLT Phase-2 baseline in CMSSW_20_1_0_pre3](https://uaf-2.t2.ucsd.edu/~bdanzi/plots_GeometryComparison_pre3_500evt_baseline/)
Presentation: [Tracker DPG Material Budget meeting](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1724608/contributions/7289115/attachments/3350596/6007521/TRKDPGGeometry25Sept2026.pdf)

FYI @cms-sw/trk-dpg-l2 @bartonaz  @cms-sw/tracking-pog-l2
title: Use fine-grained phi-resolved Phase-2 tracker material for RECO
